source_title: GM Quality System Basics Overview - Supplier Audit

scope.boundary: Assignment Action Sheet; Quality Feedback/Feed Forward; Performance Metrics

fragments.title: Assignment Action Sheet
fragments.text: Issues arising at the daily Verification Station or weekly Problem Solving report-out meeting are captured as assignments and reviewed at the next meeting. Issues may concern material presentation, delivery, or support needed to perform work better, faster, or more accurately.
fragments.candidate_scope: mechanism for recording and reviewing assignments

fragments.title: Quality Feedback / Feed Forward
fragments.text: Quality expectations and results are communicated between customers and suppliers through standardized communication pathways so information reaches those who need it.

fragments.title: Verification Station effectiveness question
fragments.text: How do we know that the Verification Station is doing its job and driving quality back into the station?
fragments.candidate_scope: control question for effectiveness of the feedback loop

fragments.title: Quality feedback paths
fragments.text: Feedback includes defects found through internal audit or containment checks, issues caught through supplier contact, and issues that escaped to the customer and were found by the customer.
fragments.candidate_scope: classification of feedback and escape paths

fragments.title: Performance Metrics
fragments.text: The check portion of implementing a Verification Station is measuring effectiveness and seeing results. This can use a line graph for the number of red days for each upstream customer and internal metrics such as scrap, direct run, internal ppm, efficiency, and uptime.
fragments.candidate_scope: effectiveness measurement practice and metric set
